prDescription: Introduces several query-shaped functions that mutate state and perform side effects.

reviewQuality.summary: Multiple helpers violate command-query separation and mutate order state while looking like reads.
reviewQuality.reviewGoal: A strong review should identify the command-query problem and avoid spending most of its attention on minor literals or loop style.

mustFind.description: Flags at least one query-with-side-effect function clearly

mustAvoid.description: Avoids leading with the magic number or loop style instead of the command-query issue

prioritise.description: The first comment should be about query-side-effects

dimensions.name: prioritisation
dimensions.description: Did the reviewer put the command-query issue ahead of lesser observations?

dimensions.name: specificity
dimensions.description: Did it explain why these query-shaped APIs are dangerous to maintain?
